Name: cancelOrderSaga
Comment:
D-113: Saga state machine for explicit order cancellation.

Forward path:
  1) cancelOrder     - mark the order CANCELLED (state transition PAID/PENDING -> CANCELLED).
  2) releaseStock    - return reserved units to inventory.
  3) refundPayment   - instruct the OPM Payment middle platform to refund.

This is a one-directional cancellation flow; the forward path itself is the
compensation of the original create-order saga. No further compensation is
registered for these steps (the operators reconcile any partial failure
out-of-band, mirroring the existing best-effort semantics in refundOrder).

States.Name: CancelOrder
States.Comment: Forward step 1: flip the order row to CANCELLED.

States.Name: ReleaseStock
States.Comment: Forward step 2: release the reserved units back to inventory.

States.Name: RefundPayment
States.Comment: Forward step 3 (final): instruct the OPM Payment middle platform to refund.
